import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    g1 = 1-np.exp(-params[0]*t)
    g2 = 1-np.exp(-params[1]*t)
    return (params[2] + params[3]*g1 + params[4]*g2
            + P*(params[5] + params[6]*g1 + params[7]*g2 + params[8]*t)
            + P**2*(params[9] + 0.0*t))
